checker.scope: Temporary authoring tool; not a runtime dependency

method: Producer-specific explicit input/source/actual served resource/decoded model bindings against current native models and runtime/data. Seventeen child reports resolve from package-root reportPackagePath and their exact receipts. Historical witness hashes are not recursively interpreted.

scope.uiLimit: UI producer records five stable disk inputs rather than served-response/model hashes; those exact current inputs and globally verified offline payloads are checked without inventing extra UI observations.
scope.notMeasured: No new geometry, motion, art or phone-performance acceptance is inferred.
